summary: A wild-west saloon bar: a 3.6 m polished walnut-topped counter whose customer face is a die of raised panels… joints bar_flap, bar_gate; options wood, rail, stock; sockets serve_0, serve_1, serve_2, serve_3, socket_bartender.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.saloon_bar_counter or place "prefab": "saloon_bar_counter" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
